smoke_type: real-data full SCENIC+ E2E via public pipeline.run — third independent dataset (PBMC granulocyte-sorted 10k human multiome)
api_call: rustscenic.pipeline.run(rna=adata, output_dir=..., adata_atac=adata_atac, motif_rankings=hs_rankings, gene_coords=hs_coords, tfs='hs', grn_n_estimators=100, topics_n_topics=15, topics_n_passes=3, eregulon_min_target_genes=2, eregulon_min_enhancer_links=1, seed=777)
supported_claims: rustscenic v0.4.3 pipeline.run completes E2E on a third public real-data multiome (PBMC granulocyte-sorted 10k human)
All 7 SCENIC+ stages produce non-empty output on this dataset
PipelineResult v0.4.3 field-contract holds on the no-pruning path: pruned_regulons_path is None, n_regulons == n_candidate_regulons, regulon_source is a non-empty string
Of 10 canonical PBMC+granulocyte TFs (myeloid + lymphoid), 10 are present in the active regulon set by name
scope_notes: Third real multiome dataset on record after PBMC 3k (v0.3.9) and mouse brain E18 5k (v0.3.10).
Different cell composition than the prior PBMC 3k run: granulocyte-sorted, so the myeloid TF axis (SPI1/CEBPA/CEBPB) gets tested in addition to lymphoid TFs (PAX5/GATA3/TBX21).
Pre-pipeline setup time (RNA QC, ATAC subset, motif/gene-coords download) recorded separately from pipeline.run wall.
ATAC matrix pre-subset to RNA-QC'd cells (the v0.3.8 adata_atac path).
GRN n_estimators=100 is the smoke speed; README's quoted parity number uses n_estimators=5000.
eRegulon thresholds permissive (min_target_genes=2, min_enhancer_links=1) for orchestration proof.
Topics method=vb (default), n_topics=15 to reflect PBMC+granulocyte diversity.
Biological sanity is name-presence in the regulon set, NOT cell-type enrichment.

Motif-annotation pruning (v0.4.2 feature) NOT exercised here — motif_annotations argument not supplied, so the no-pruning path is tested. v0.4.3 fix verified: pruned_regulons_path is None, not a stale empty-dict file.
open_gates: Cell-type enrichment of recovered TFs: requires AnnData with cluster labels + AUCell-per-cluster F-test or ARI-vs-RNA-cluster. Tracked for follow-up.
Cistarget motif-annotation pruning + NES path on this dataset: deferred to v0.4.4 (NES PR).
Cross-tool parity vs pycistarget on this dataset: blocked on pycistarget's installability.
